name: CompositionSpec
rule: A structural plan object holding the three canonical semantic dimensions. It is NOT a fourth vocabulary: it defines no new enum member and reuses the three owners named in CANONICAL_MAPPING.json.

fields.name: speaker_visibility
fields.question: Which speaker(s), if any, are visible and how?

fields.name: layout_mode
fields.question: How is the visual space geometrically organised?

fields.name: parameters
fields.question: Configuration, not vocabulary. Validated per layout_mode.

non_collapse: The three dimensions are stored separately and are never folded into a single enum. A change to one must not imply a change to another.
fail_closed: parameters invalid for the selected layout_mode
layout_mode requires a subject track and none is supplied
forbidden_behaviours: persisting a derived value as if it were an authoritative input
